tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Experts urge global regulation amid rapid development and risks of rogue artificial intelligence, though government intervention could be tricky. Confirmed by Yahoo News Canada.
Mathematicians challenge OpenAI's Navier-Stokes proof and multi-agent contribution claims still open per The Decoder.
China adds 40 technologies to its export list including artificial intelligence, while Taiwan tightens controls to block illegal hardware shipments. Confirmed by 鉅亨網.
Reported by Yeni Şafak English: Anthropic proposes a federal artificial intelligence safety law to US Congress.
Anthropic and Harvard used artificial intelligence to design quantum circuits cutting operations and qubits by up to 12 times. Reported by The Quantum Insider.
